name: Assemble a traceable evidence packet
summary: A planned research capability for organizing source-aware evidence around a defined question.

discovery_contract.user_job: Organize a research question around entities, sources, time, known facts, interpretations, gaps and usage boundaries.
use_when: A person or agent needs a source-aware starting point for further analysis.
The research question and time context can be defined.
do_not_use_when: The request requires data that INVERT has no right to display or redistribute.
The user expects a complete investment decision rather than an evidence set.

known_limitations: Field-level data rights are not yet locked.
Freshness and source coverage targets are not yet published.
No public evaluation set has been released.

availability_note: No public API or MCP endpoint is available.
